Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
PatternId
The ID of the pattern
MobileDetectionId
An ID to relate a mobile detection event with its data events.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
IsEcho
If true, this event is a repeat of the same event that was sent previously.
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
